title: Luca application v1 contract exchanges
description: Draft adapter contracts, not canonical ledger encoding or an implemented server. Definitions define operation inputs/results; root validates illustrative request/response exchanges.

utf8.description: Also enforce <=65536 UTF-8 bytes and the configured lower limit.

x-luca-mcp-tools.description: Read supported operations, contexts, formats, limits and retention for an authorized book.
Optional local-only tool. Copy a file from a configured input-root ID into durable staging. Reject root escapes/symlinks; this is not an import receipt.
Durably receive transaction bytes and processing intent; return before asynchronous financial validation. Retry identical content/options with the same key.
Read retained import status. Counts cover enumerated records; receipt is distinct from validation and commitment.
Read a bounded snapshot page of staged records. Retain validation and commitment separately; repeat filters with a cursor.
Read retained errors/blocked reasons as data, including import-level enumeration errors.
Schedule version-checked revalidation of explicit groups against an immutable context. Preserve prior errors; do not bypass ledger admission.
Create a durable report job with explicit context, cutoffs and readiness. Return job receipt, not computed rows; poll status.
Read durable job state, pinned coverage, complete result manifest or retained failure.
Read rows from one immutable available report result. All pages and totals share its pinned revision/context.
Read paginated source/event/journal lineage for a row or causal evidence ID in this report result. No arbitrary file or SQL access.
